fields.description: Hub-wide values every client's access-guard needs. The per-site transport token is set on each Remote Site.
fields.label: Enrollment Info

fields.description: Effective session length is min(this, the client site's own System Settings session_expiry). Default 6h.
fields.label: Session Expiry (seconds)

fields.description: One doctype per line. Writes to these are always logged in full (after_commit), regardless of the deny/warn rules above.
fields.label: Always-Log Doctypes

fields.description: When off, pure-read whitelisted calls (see protocol.READ_SKIP_METHODS) are not logged.
fields.label: Log Reads

fields.description: Best-effort push of this policy to reachable guards on save; guards also pull hourly regardless.
fields.label: Sync Enabled

fields.description: A session's local log file is deleted once (acked by hub AND local age > this) OR age > retention_days.
fields.label: Push Grace (days)

fields.description: Appended to the ephemeral user's last_name, e.g. "John Doe (consultant)".
fields.label: Name Suffix
